summary: Raise application dependency security floors with approved mail and Git library upgrades.
userImpact: Requires successful image and runtime qualification before publication or deployment; no authentication method changes.

notes: No schema changes. The bootstrap retains its exact predecessor code, migration inventory and signed schema plan while refreshing its production dependency stores.

security: Approved Nodemailer 9 to 10 and simple-git 3 to 4 upgrades, including argv-parser 1 to 2; compatible fixes apply to HTTP transport and parser dependencies.
Application runtime dependency assembly excludes build/test dependencies while the build stage retains them.
Tedious keeps its real package identity and SQL Server support; an owned bounded diagnostic formatter replaces sprintf-js in the reviewed pnpm workspace, without a scan suppression.
knownLimitations: Standalone npm consumers do not inherit pnpm root patches; the Tedious change qualifies the shipped workspace/image composition, not an upstream sprintf-js release.
Local image and database evidence is not the signed registry candidate or live staging signup; complete protected qualification remains required.
rollback: Revert the scoped manifest and lockfile change; do not downgrade a serving system without separately qualified rollback evidence.
validation: Node 24.10.0 and pnpm 11.0.8: fifteen focused dependency/formatter/bootstrap contracts passed; the nine pre-existing TypeScript fixture errors were repaired and all eighty-four affected tests passed.

The rebuilt bootstrap passed real PostgreSQL bootstrap/idempotence/receipt/drift rejection. Local arm64 backend, frontend and bootstrap images passed the pinned all-severity scanner with unchanged ignore policy. A real SQL Server development shard passed its required stages; this is not five-adapter acceptance.

Backend typecheck and all 3780 unit tests passed with serial file scheduling; frontend typechecks and all 1562 unit tests passed. CI contracts 163/163 and routing/security contracts 85/85 passed. Initial concurrent backend tests had socket/time-out failures that all passed in focused serial reproduction before the full serial gate.
Full application image, browser, five-adapter and signed protected candidate qualification remain distinct required gates.
